name: stock_lot_condition
summary: Lets you tag each serial number or lot with a condition such as Good or Defective, and optionally require a note explaining it. Conditions are defined under Inventory > Configuration > Products > Lot conditions and show on the lot form.

name: stock_lot_image
summary: Adds a list of images, videos or embed codes to each lot or serial number, shown in an Images tab on the lot form. Handy for photographing a specific item.

name: stock_lot_list_price
summary: Lets you set a sales price (list price) on each lot or serial number, so an individual unit can carry its own price. Requires the stock_account module, and the price shows on the lot form.

name: stock_lot_multi_image
summary: Lets you attach several pictures to a lot or serial number in an Images tab, with the first image used as the main picture. It builds on the base multi-image feature.

name: stock_lot_warehouse
summary: Adds an informational Warehouse field to lots and serial numbers, so you can see which warehouse a lot belongs to. It is for reference only and does not restrict stock moves.

name: stock_move_common_dest
summary: Technical module that adds a field on stock moves listing the other moves that share the same downstream destination transfer. It is used by other chained-move features and has no screen of its own.

name: stock_move_line_lot_link
summary: Makes the lot or serial number on the Detailed Operations lines clickable, so you can jump straight to its form. Without it the lot name sometimes shows as plain text.

name: stock_move_line_reference_link
summary: Makes the Reference field on stock move lines clickable, so you can open the source document directly from the Detailed Operations view.

name: stock_move_location
summary: Adds an Operations > Move from location wizard that moves all or selected stock from one location to another in one step, either immediately or as a planned transfer. Quantities can be edited per line but cannot exceed what is available, and reservations are ignored.

name: stock_move_location_purchase_uom
summary: Glue between Move Stock Location and Purchase UoM. When the operation type uses purchase units, transfers created by the Move to location button use each product's purchase unit.

name: stock_move_packaging_qty
summary: Adds packaging quantity fields to stock moves and move lines, so a transfer can show how many packs or boxes are involved as well as units. An operation type option can calculate the done packaging quantity automatically.

name: stock_move_purchase_uom
summary: Lets an operation type use the purchase unit of measure for its stock moves, set on the operation type form along with a rounding method. Useful when you buy in cases or boxes but count in single units, or the reverse.

name: stock_move_reset_quantity
summary: Lets you reset all quantities on a transfer's moves and move lines back to zero in one action. Useful when you want to re-enter counts from scratch.

name: stock_mts_mto_rule
summary: Adds a Make To Stock plus Make To Order route. For each sale it takes what is in stock first and creates a purchase order only for the shortfall, and it is enabled per warehouse with Use MTO+MTS rules.

name: stock_package_type_volume
summary: Adds a volume measure to package types, so each package type knows its size in volume units. It shows on the package type form under Inventory settings.

name: stock_packaging_calculator
summary: Transitional module that only installs product_packaging_calculator, which has been renamed and moved. Use the packaging calculator features through that module instead.

name: stock_picking_batch_packaging_qty
summary: Shows packaging quantity columns in batch transfer views, so pickers see how many boxes or packs to take in each batch and on Detailed Operations. It needs batch transfers and product packaging turned on.

name: stock_picking_commercial_partner
summary: Adds a Commercial Entity field on transfers, taken from the customer's parent company, so you can search and group transfers by the company they belong to. It appears on the transfer form and list view.

name: stock_picking_completion_info
summary: Shows a ribbon on a transfer when completing it unlocks the next chained transfers, so the operator knows the downstream step can now be processed. It is switched on per operation type.

name: stock_picking_procure_method
summary: Lets a transfer use the Apply Procurement Rules supply method instead of Take From Stock, so a planned transfer can trigger make-to-order flows such as purchases or manufacturing. It is set in the Supply Method field on the transfer.

name: stock_picking_product_assortment
summary: Limits the products that can be added to a transfer for a partner to that partner's product assortment, so only allowed products (or only non-blacklisted ones) can be picked. It uses the product_assortment setup.

name: stock_picking_show_linked
summary: Adds a smart button on a transfer to open the previous transfers in a chained route, so you can move between linked steps quickly. It is useful with multi-step deliveries and receipts.

name: stock_picking_stage
summary: Adds a Stage field to transfers so you can track where each one sits in your own workflow, using colored stages you define. The stages are kept in their own list and shown on the transfer form.

name: stock_picking_supplier_ref
summary: Adds a Supplier Delivery Reference field on receipts, to hold the vendor's own reference or delivery note number, and makes it searchable. The field only appears on incoming transfers.

name: stock_picking_volume
summary: Computes the total volume of each transfer and its moves from product dimensions, so you know its size for planning trucks or handling equipment. The value follows the move state, using the done quantity or the quantity still to do.

name: stock_picking_volume_packaging
summary: Refines the transfer volume by using the volume of the product packaging that can be picked for a move, where that volume is recorded. Where packaging has no volume, it falls back to the product volume.

name: stock_product_qty_by_packaging
summary: Glue module that shows the quantity in packaging terms (for example 3 boxes) on stock moves, move lines and quants, and displays it on the move lines of a transfer. It needs the packaging calculator.

name: stock_putaway_product_template
summary: Lets you define putaway rules on the product template from the product form, instead of on each variant. It requires Storage Locations and the push and pull flows setting.

name: stock_quant_cost_info
summary: Adds an Adjustment Cost column to the Physical Inventory details and its PDF report, calculated as the counted-minus-theoretical quantity times the product cost. It shows the value effect of a stock count before you apply it.

name: stock_quant_reservation_info
summary: Lets you see, from a product's on-hand view, which transfers or manufacturing orders are reserving its stock, and jump to them. A button next to the reserved quantity opens the related transfers.

name: stock_quant_reservation_info_mrp
summary: Extends the reservation lookup so reserved stock can be traced to the manufacturing order holding it, not only to transfers. It needs Manufacturing installed.

name: stock_removal_location_by_priority
summary: Adds a removal priority to stock locations, so when two locations hold stock of the same date the higher-priority one is used first. It is switched on in Inventory settings and set on each location.

name: stock_restrict_immediate_adjustment
summary: Makes the stock quantity list read-only when it is opened from a product's On Hand button or the inventory report, so quantities can only be changed through Inventory Adjustments with an explicit Apply. It prevents accidental stock changes.

name: stock_route_location_source
summary: Technical module that adds a helper on routes to find the true source location of a destination by following upstream pull rules. It has no screens; other modules call it.

name: stock_route_mto
summary: Adds an MTO checkbox on routes, so you can mark which routes are make-to-order and filter for them in the route list.

name: stock_secondary_unit
summary: Lets a product carry a second unit of measure with a conversion factor, so stock quantities can be shown and entered in both units. The second-unit quantity appears on the product list and on stock moves.

name: stock_storage_category_capacity_name
summary: Gives storage category capacity records a readable name in the interface, which core Odoo does not provide. It is mostly a display improvement in the storage category settings.

name: stock_valuation_layer_inventory_filter
summary: Lets you filter the valuation report to inventory adjustment moves, group it by reference and filter by date, so you can see what each stock count changed in value. It is found under Inventory > Reporting > Valuation and needs stock_account.

name: stock_vertical_lift
summary: Core setup for Vertical Lift Modules, the automated shelving machines such as Kardex or Modula. It adds shuttle and tray configuration on locations and dedicated screens to pick, put away and count stock; the physical drivers come from other addons.

name: stock_vertical_lift_empty_tray_check
summary: After a tray is released and the system thinks it is empty, it asks the operator to confirm that it really is. An inventory adjustment is then posted to zero if it is empty, or left in draft if not. It is enabled in Inventory settings.

name: stock_vertical_lift_packaging_level
summary: Glue module that shows the full packaging level name instead of the plain packaging name on vertical lift screens. It installs automatically when packaging levels are present.

name: stock_vertical_lift_pick_priority
summary: On a vertical lift, the pick screen lists goods for the most urgent outgoing deliveries first, based on the priority and date of the deliveries waiting for them. Skipped lines still come last, and it relies on the urgent-transfers setting from the vertical lift module.

name: stock_vertical_lift_qty_by_packaging
summary: Glue module that adds the quantity-by-packaging display (for example 3 boxes) to the vertical lift transfer screen. It needs both the packaging quantity and vertical lift modules.

name: stock_vertical_lift_server_env
summary: Adds OCA Server Environment settings to vertical lift shuttles, so connection details can differ between environments such as test and production. It is a technical integration layer.

name: stock_vertical_lift_storage_type
summary: Makes vertical lift putaways respect storage types: when a package has a storage type, the operator is not asked to scan a tray type and the matching putaway is applied. Tray storage types are set on the tray types.

name: stock_vlm_mgmt
summary: Lightweight management for Vertical Lift Modules: define trays and tray types on locations, track what sits in each tray, and handle lift pick, put and transfer tasks from transfers. It is a simpler alternative to the full vertical lift setup.

name: stock_vlm_mgmt_kardex
summary: Adds Kardex as a vendor choice for vertical lift locations in the lightweight VLM module. It only sets the vendor selection; machine communication is provided elsewhere.

name: stock_vlm_mgmt_modula
summary: Adds Modula as a vendor choice for vertical lift locations in the lightweight VLM module. It only sets the vendor selection; machine communication is provided elsewhere.

name: stock_warehouse_calendar
summary: Attaches a working schedule to each warehouse, so generated transfers get start dates that account for lead times and working hours. For example, a move needed on a Monday is started on the last working day before it. It is set on the warehouse form.

name: stock_warehouse_out_pull
summary: Restores pull rules for outgoing deliveries as they worked before Odoo 18, so a multi-step delivery creates its chained transfers from one procurement. It is enabled per warehouse with the Outgoing Pull Rules option.

name: stock_warehouse_resupply_route_push
summary: Switches inter-warehouse resupply to push rules. A first transfer moves stock from the source warehouse to an inter-warehouse location, and only after it is done does a second transfer take it to the receiving warehouse. It is enabled per warehouse with a regenerate button.

name: stock_warehouse_security
summary: Restricts which warehouses each user can see and work in, set on the user form. A user with no warehouses listed can see all of them.

name: delivery_procurement_group_carrier
summary: Technical glue that copies the sales order's delivery carrier onto the procurement group, so the carrier can drive routing and the grouping of deliveries. It has no screen of its own.

name: delivery_total_weight_from_packaging
summary: Makes move, transfer and package weights include the weight of the packaging, not just the products. This affects the shipping weight used on delivery packages.

name: procurement_auto_create_group_carrier
summary: Glue module that stores the delivery carrier on the procurement group when procurement groups are created automatically. It is technical and has no screens.

name: product_cost_price_avco_sync
summary: For average-cost (AVCO) products, correcting the cost or quantity of a validated receipt restates its valuation layer and re-prices the outgoing moves valued after it, so the product cost and reported margins stay right. Use it only with manual inventory valuation, not automated.

name: product_customerinfo_picking
summary: Shows the customer's own product code and name on each stock move in a transfer, taken from the customer product info on the product. Useful when a customer refers to items by their own codes.

name: purchase_stock_picking_invoice_link
summary: Links purchase orders, receipts and vendor bills, so from a vendor bill you can open the receipts it relates to through a Delivery smart button. It extends the basic invoice-to-transfer link to purchasing.

name: sale_line_returned_qty
summary: Shows a Returned Qty column on sales order lines once a return delivery is validated, so you can see how much a customer sent back.

name: sale_line_returned_qty_mrp
summary: Makes the returned quantity work for kit (BoM) products on sales lines. It installs automatically with manufacturing and has no screens of its own.

name: sale_order_global_stock_route
summary: Lets a sales quotation carry one route, such as a particular warehouse path, that applies to all of its lines. It is set in the Route field on the quotation and needs Multi-Step Routes enabled.

name: sale_stock_picking_invoice_link
summary: Links sales orders, deliveries and customer invoices, so each invoice shows which deliveries it relates to on a Pickings tab. It is useful for partial deliveries and for invoice reports grouped by delivery, for products invoiced on delivery.

name: sale_stock_restocking_fee_invoicing
summary: When a customer returns goods, the return wizard can add a restocking fee to the sales order, for the whole return or per line. The fee product is set in Inventory settings under Valuation.

name: scrap_reason_code
summary: Adds reason codes to scrap orders, each with a fixed scrap location and optional allowed product categories, so every scrap is recorded with a reason. Codes are managed under Inventory > Configuration > Scrap Reason Codes.

name: stock_account_product_run_fifo_hook
summary: Technical hook in the FIFO cost calculation, so other modules can change what is stored on FIFO candidates. It is developer-facing and has no screens.

name: stock_account_show_automatic_valuation
summary: Shows the Automatic Valuation option in Inventory settings for Community edition, where Odoo hid it. It lets you choose automated inventory valuation for stock movements.

name: stock_checkout_sync
summary: Adds a Checkout Sync action on pick transfers that moves the related packing lines to one chosen packing location, so all goods for an order gather in the same place. It is switched on per operation type.

name: stock_dangerous_goods
summary: Adds flags showing whether products, move lines or packages contain dangerous goods in limited quantity. It is a glue module with the EU dangerous goods (ADR) product module.

name: stock_dynamic_routing
summary: Routes stock moves by the location they come from or go to. For example, goods leaving a high-bay can automatically get an extra handover transfer when reserved. Routing rules are set under Inventory settings in the Stock Routing menu.

name: stock_dynamic_routing_checkout_sync
summary: Glue module with tests that confirm checkout sync and dynamic routing work together. It adds no features of its own.

name: stock_dynamic_routing_delivery
summary: Lets selected dynamic routing rules pass the carrier onto the extra routing moves they create. It is set per routing rule with the Propagation of carrier option.

name: stock_dynamic_routing_delivery_procurement_group_carrier
summary: Glue module so the carrier taken from the procurement group, rather than the transfer, is used when carriers are passed on in dynamic routing.

name: stock_dynamic_routing_reserve_rule
summary: Glue module that adds a warning on routing records when a reservation rule applies, so users see the conflict in the routing form.

name: stock_landed_costs_priority
summary: Adds a priority level to landed costs, so you can rank them by importance or urgency.

name: stock_landed_costs_purchase_auto
summary: Creates a landed cost record automatically when a purchase order is confirmed, linked to the order and to its receipt once validated. It is found under Inventory > Operations > Landed Costs.

name: stock_lock_lot
summary: Lets you block a serial number or lot so it cannot move into a location unless that location allows locked stock. The default for new lots can be set per product category.

name: stock_lot_scrap
summary: Adds a Scrap button on the lot or serial number form that scraps all stock quants in that lot. It requires Lots & Serial Numbers to be turned on in traceability settings.

name: stock_move_actual_date
summary: Adds an Actual Date to transfers, scraps and moves, to record when a movement really happened if it is entered late. Valuation layers and stock history reports use this date, and users need the Modify Actual Date group to edit it.

name: stock_move_auto_assign_auto_release
summary: Once a move becomes available, releases the waiting moves automatically in background jobs, one job per product, so users are not slowed down. It builds on auto assign and delayed release of moves.

name: stock_move_backdating
summary: Lets you record a transfer with a past movement date (Forced Effective Date), which also sets the journal entry date when perpetual valuation is on. Use it when stock was physically moved earlier but is only entered now.

name: stock_move_forced_lot
summary: Lets a procurement force a specific lot onto the stock move it creates, so only that lot is reserved. Useful when a particular serial number must be shipped.

name: stock_move_line_change_lot
summary: When you change the lot on a move line, it checks availability and takes over reservations from other lines if needed, without taking from lines already picked. If only part of the quantity is available, the line is split so the rest is covered.

name: stock_move_line_dates
summary: Adds Scheduled Date and Deadline to move lines, so you can filter and group wave planning by when lines are due. It is used from the Prepare Wave option on an operation type.

name: stock_move_line_expiration_date_required
summary: For products set to a zero-day expiry, forces the expiration date to be entered by hand on move lines instead of calculated. A transfer cannot be confirmed until those dates are filled in.

name: stock_move_line_qty_picked
summary: Adds a separate Picked quantity on move lines, so scanning counts does not change the reserved quantity. It brings back the done-quantity behavior from earlier Odoo versions.

name: stock_move_original_date
summary: Keeps the original scheduled date on a move when the date is later changed, so supplier delays can be measured against the planned date. It is shown on moves and transfers.

name: stock_move_propagate_first_move
summary: Records on each move the first move and first operation type of the procurement chain that created it, so you can tell at a glance whether it belongs to an incoming or outgoing process.

name: stock_move_quantity_product_uom
summary: Shows a move's quantity in the product's own unit of measure, which can differ from the unit used on the move. It helps reports where units are mixed.

name: stock_move_source_relocate
summary: Changes the source location of moves that cannot be filled where they are, using relocation rules by location, operation type and an optional domain. Useful for handling replenishments from one central spot, and partly available moves are split.

name: stock_move_source_relocate_dynamic_routing
summary: Glue module so source relocation works with dynamic routing, letting relocated moves pick up the routing that applies to their new source.

name: stock_move_vendor_comment
summary: Adds a Vendor Comment field to stock moves and move lines, for notes coming from the supplier.

name: stock_no_negative
summary: Blocks validation of any stock operation that would leave a stockable product with negative quantity at a location, so the stock must be fixed first. Exceptions can be set per product, product category or location with the Allow Negative Stock option.

name: stock_override_procurement
summary: Technical module that lets code override location and other fields of a procurement through the values passed in. Developers use it; there are no screens.

name: stock_owner_restriction
summary: Keeps stock owned by a specific partner, such as consignment stock, out of reservations made for other operations. The restriction is chosen per operation type, and consignment must be enabled in Traceability settings.

name: stock_partner_delivery_window
summary: Lets each customer have a preferred delivery time window or weekday, and warns when a delivery's scheduled date falls outside it. It is set on the customer's Sales & Purchases tab.

name: stock_picking_auto_create_lot
summary: Creates lots automatically when a receipt is validated without lot numbers, for products and operation types set to auto-create. It is switched on per product and per operation type.

name: stock_picking_auto_create_lot_sequence
summary: Bridge module so lots created automatically use the lot numbering sequence from the product lot sequence module. It is technical and has no screens.

name: stock_picking_auto_create_package
summary: On validation, puts all move lines of a transfer into a new package, either one package for the whole transfer or one per product packaging. The mode is set on the operation type.

name: stock_picking_back2draft
summary: Lets you reopen a cancelled transfer and set it back to draft with a button, for example when it needs to be processed after all.

name: stock_picking_backorder_strategy_cancel
summary: Adds a Cancel option to the Create Backorder setting on operation types, so leftover quantities from a partial receipt or delivery are cancelled instead of creating a backorder.

name: stock_picking_batch_account
summary: When a batch is set to Done, automatically creates invoices for the sales orders behind its transfers, for customers who have opted in. It can also print those invoices from the batch.

name: stock_picking_batch_account_sale_type
summary: Lets a sales order type turn on automatic batch invoicing, so batches for orders of that type are invoiced when done. It extends batch invoicing to sales order types.

name: stock_picking_batch_creation
summary: Creates a batch of transfers on demand from a Make Picking Batch wizard, filtering by operation types, device capacity (weight, volume, bins) and maximum lines, and optionally grouping by partner or priority. It is found under Inventory > Operations.

name: stock_picking_batch_creation_split_kit
summary: When a batch is created, splits kit transfers so that each device's compartment limit is respected. It extends the batch creation wizard using kit splitting.

name: stock_picking_batch_extended
summary: Adds a name, notes, grouping options and extra fields to batch transfer creation and the batch form, plus a batch picking report. Batch validation can also be switched to the OCA approach per company.

name: stock_picking_batch_invoice_frequency
summary: Lets sales orders with an invoice frequency be invoiced automatically when their transfers are put in a batch and validated. It is enabled with Automatic Batch Invoicing on the invoice frequency.

name: stock_picking_batch_operation_quick_change
summary: Lets you change the destination location of all operations in a batch at once, using a wizard. You choose the old and new destinations, optionally for all lines.

name: stock_picking_batch_outgoing
summary: Shows the outgoing batch on the origin transfers in multi-step routes, so you can see which batch picked up each step. It depends on the first-move propagation module.

name: stock_picking_batch_planner
summary: Plans origin batches or waves from a destination batch with one click, using the grouping rules on the operation type, and adds smart buttons to the linked batches or waves. It is used with two-step or three-step deliveries.

name: stock_picking_batch_print_invoices
summary: Prints invoices from a batch, depending on the operation type setting: invoices only, invoices and pickings, or either. It needs the batch pickings printing module.

name: stock_picking_batch_print_pickings
summary: Prints picking documents for a whole batch at once, set per operation type with a number of copies. It needs batch transfers turned on.

name: stock_picking_batch_validate_confirm
summary: When a batch is validated while some origin moves are still pending, shows a confirmation listing those moves. Users need the Validate Incomplete Batches group to confirm.

name: stock_picking_consolidation_priority
summary: Raises the priority of all related transfers in a chain once packing has started on one of them, so an order already being picked is pushed through. It is enabled with a setting on the operation type.

name: stock_picking_customer_ref
summary: Shows the sales order's Customer Reference on each related transfer, and makes it searchable. The reference entered on the sales order appears on the delivery.

name: stock_picking_date_deadline_syncs_scheduled_date
summary: Keeps a transfer's Scheduled Date aligned with its Deadline when the deadline changes, while still letting you move the scheduled date freely. Deadlines come from the sales commitment date or the move deadline.

name: stock_picking_filter_lot
summary: On outgoing transfers and scraps, only shows lots that exist in the origin location when you pick them. Lots need a company set for the filter to work.

name: stock_picking_group_by_base
summary: Technical module that provides a helper for adding database indexes used by transfer grouping features. Developers call it from other grouping modules; it has no screens.

name: stock_picking_group_by_partner_by_carrier
summary: Combines several sales orders for the same customer and carrier into one delivery order, placed in an existing open delivery with the same address. Orders set to ship when all products are ready always get their own delivery. It is enabled per warehouse or operation type.

name: stock_picking_group_by_partner_by_carrier_by_date
summary: Adds the scheduled date to delivery grouping, so deliveries are merged only when they share the same date as well as the same customer and carrier. It is turned on per operation type.

name: stock_picking_group_by_partner_by_carrier_force_move_type
summary: Glue module so that forcing a shipping policy on a picking type works together with grouping deliveries by partner and carrier. It is technical and has no screens.

name: stock_picking_immediate_transfer_warning
summary: When a reserved transfer is validated without anything marked as picked, shows a warning that all reserved quantities will be processed, with Process or Discard buttons. It only appears when validating from the screen.

name: stock_picking_import_serial_number
summary: Lets you import serial numbers from an Excel file onto an incoming transfer, matching products and columns set in settings. It is useful for large receipts with many serial numbers.

name: stock_picking_invoice_link
summary: Base module that links transfers to invoices: each invoice gets a Pickings tab, and each transfer shows its invoices. The sales and purchase link modules are built on top of it.

name: stock_picking_kind
summary: Adds a Picking Kind field to transfers, computed from the source and destination locations (for example receipt, delivery or internal), so the type of movement can be filtered.

name: stock_picking_line_sequence
summary: Adds a sequence number to each line of a transfer and lets you reorder the lines, so they show in a fixed order.

name: stock_picking_mass_action
summary: From a transfer list, applies Mark as Todo, Check Availability, Force Availability or Transfer to many selected transfers at once. A scheduled action can also check availability in the background, and it is off by default.

name: stock_picking_operation_quick_change
summary: Lets you change the destination location of all operations in a single transfer at once, from a wizard. You choose the old and new location, optionally for all lines.

name: stock_picking_origin_reference
summary: Turns the Source Document on transfers into a clickable link to the document it came from, when a matching record exists. Sales and purchase navigation is added automatically when those apps are installed.

name: stock_picking_origin_reference_purchase
summary: Makes the source document link on a transfer open the originating purchase order.

name: stock_picking_origin_reference_sale
summary: Makes the source document link on a transfer open the originating sales order.

name: stock_picking_partner_note
summary: Adds customer-specific preparation notes to transfers. Notes are kept on the customer, filtered by a note type set on the shipping operation type, and can be locked against edits when shared by several customers.

name: stock_picking_partner_vat
summary: Shows the customer or vendor VAT number on the transfer form and on the Picking Operations and Delivery Slip reports.

name: stock_picking_progress
summary: Adds a progress percentage on moves (share of quantity processed) and on transfers (the average across their moves). It is shown on the transfer and move views.

name: stock_picking_propagate_scheduled_date
summary: When a move's scheduled date changes, the same time shift is applied to the chained moves downstream, keeping a multi-step delivery in sync.

name: stock_picking_purchase_order_link
summary: Adds a Purchase Order smart button on a receipt that opens the purchase order it was created from.

name: stock_picking_restrict_cancel_printed
summary: Shows a printed flag on transfers and blocks cancelling a transfer once it has been printed, unless the operation type allows it. The restriction is set per operation type.
